text: Appendix E The Algorithm of KVSmooth In this section, we present the full algorithmic details of KVSmooth. The algorithm consists of two components: Algorithm 1: EMA Smoothing on KV-Cache, corresponding to Section 4.3 (The Final KVSmooth Method); and Algorithm 2: Attention Forward with Adaptive EMA Smoothing, corresponding to Section 3.1 (Formulation of MLLMs Generation) and Section 4.2 (Entropy-Guided Coefficient Adaptation).
